caption: The drawing is a black-and-white line illustration depicting an architectural detail of a carved frame. In the upper left quadrant, a vertical column extends upward to support a horizontal beam running along the top edge of the composition. The column features ornate carvings, including repeating vertical lines and decorative patterns near the top. The upper horizontal beam is decorated with two bands of circular motifs and intricate patterns. A diagonal, curved brace connects the corner where the vertical column and the horizontal beam meet, and this brace is also decorated with carved details, including a series of parallel lines that fan outward. The background is plain and unadorned. There is a thin rectangular border framing the drawing. Below the border, text reads "USS Hartford" on the left and "Carved Frame of Bunk" on the right. The entire drawing and text appear on an off-white or light cream background.
title: Carved Frame of Bunk
